scripts.build:studio: cd sanity && npm run build && cp -r dist ../.output/public/admin && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const f='../.output/public/admin/index.html'; let h=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); h=h.replace(/\"\/static\//g,'\"/admin/static/'); fs.writeFileSync(f,h);"
scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:studio
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy .output/public --project-name=fairbanks-shakespeare --branch=development
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy .output/public --project-name=fairbanks-shakespeare --branch=main
